S.FORM: == qhoniq == baq smli' qsya' qu gamil na qhuniq hiya'. 'n_gyutun nya' posa' qu qsya'. msturing ru mssli'. wal mskura' sa gong ru llyung. hya' ga qhuniq sawn uzi qu kkayal, qhuniq qani hya ga mutuw galan qayqaya' na ngasal ini' ga qayqaya' pptzyuwaw qmayah. qhniq hya ga aring sa gamil ru tunux na qhuniq lru qbuci' niya' lru yaqu qara' niya' kya la, musa' tay llyuw lga nanu' yaqu abaw kya la. qbuci' na qhuniq lga, kya qu yulaq ru hi' na qhuniq, maki' squ hi' na qhuniq ga mluw squ inrkyasan niya' ru kya uzi qu si pgluq mshzyu' kruma' qu tuqi hya', ga kya uzi qu ptqipay la tuqi na inrkyasan niya' uzi. kruma' ga yasa qu ptqara' lga, m'mumu' haru hmbku' kya qu qara' niya' la. tayhuk sa pkbwazyan niya' lga, ptnaral hru mkphpah kya la, ru wahan p'imaw na hzing qu qmu' na phpah niya' lga, yasa qu thuzyay' maki' qu bway niya' la, nanu' blaq qu pinkbway niya' ga, krahu' qu bway niya' lru thuzyay' kya uzi qu qpuri' niya' la, nanu' yaqu qpuri' niya' qasa qu mshutaw lru hmbku' kya lawzi qu hbku' na qhuniq giqas lawzi la.
S.PHON: qħoniq βaq [s|ɕ]mliʔ q[s|ɕ]jaʔ qu ɣamil na qħuniq ħijaʔ ʔnɣjutun njaʔ po[s|ɕ]aʔ qu q[s|ɕ]jaʔ m[s|ɕ]turiŋ ru m[s|ɕ][s|ɕ]liʔ wal m[s|ɕ]kuraʔ [s|ɕ]a ɣoŋ ru lljuŋ ħjaʔ ɣa qħuniq [s|ɕ]awn uzi qu kkajal qħuniq qani ħja ɣa mutuw ɣalan qajqajaʔ na ŋa[s|ɕ]al iniʔ ɣa qajqajaʔ pptzjuwaw qmajaħ qħniq ħja ɣa ariŋ [s|ɕ]a ɣamil ru tunux na qħuniq lru qβu[ʦ|ʨ]iʔ nijaʔ lru jaqu qaraʔ nijaʔ kja la mu[s|ɕ]aʔ taj lljuw lɣa nanuʔ jaqu aβaw kja la qβu[ʦ|ʨ]iʔ na qħuniq lɣa kja qu julaq ru ħiʔ na qħuniq makiʔ [s|ɕ]qu ħiʔ na qħuniq ɣa mluw [s|ɕ]qu inrkja[s|ɕ]an nijaʔ ru kja uzi qu [s|ɕ]i pɣluq m[s|ɕ]ħzjuʔ krumaʔ qu tuqi ħjaʔ ɣa kja uzi qu ptqipaj la tuqi na inrkja[s|ɕ]an nijaʔ uzi krumaʔ ɣa ja[s|ɕ]a qu ptqaraʔ lɣa mʔmumuʔ ħaru ħmβkuʔ kja qu qaraʔ nijaʔ la tajħuk [s|ɕ]a pkβwazjan nijaʔ lɣa ptnaral ħru mkpħpaħ kja la ru waħan pʔimaw na ħziŋ qu qmuʔ na pħpaħ nijaʔ lɣa ja[s|ɕ]a qu tħuzjajʔ makiʔ qu βwaj nijaʔ la nanuʔ βlaq qu pinkβwaj nijaʔ ɣa kraħuʔ qu βwaj nijaʔ lru tħuzjajʔ kja uzi qu qpuriʔ nijaʔ la nanuʔ jaqu qpuriʔ nijaʔ qa[s|ɕ]a qu m[s|ɕ]ħutaw lru ħmβkuʔ kja lawzi qu ħβkuʔ na qħuniq ɣiqa[s|ɕ] lawzi la
